root_cause: Hosted Streamlit and CI disagreed even after a hosted reboot: CI resolved one verified 2026-09-24 ATL@GB game while the public V46 control deck returned zero. V42 temporarily mutated the shared nfl_hub_v25.load_nfl_slate module attribute during render. Streamlit sessions share an interpreter, so concurrent sessions can observe or restore that temporary mutation across reruns; single-session CI does not reproduce that interleaving.
patch: Pin the primary ESPN daily loader to nfl_hub_v1.load_nfl_slate, have V42 visible labels call the full-slate router directly, and give frozen V8 a temporary module proxy whose load_nfl_slate resolves to the full-slate router without mutating nfl_hub_v25 globally.
